note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: Finney's lecture texts (Hab 3:2, Ps 85:6, James 5:16, Mark 11:24, Rom 8:26-27, Eph 5:18, Matt 18:19, Job 21:34, Acts 16:30, John 21:15, 2 Pet 3:18), the long recitations (Mark 11:21-25, Rom 8:13-16, 1 John 4:1-3, Rom 9:1-3, James 5:19-20, Exod 17:11-13, John 21:15-17), the verses inside Edwards' long quotation in Lecture 4, and the phrases he quotes again inside his own sentences.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where OWB opens an inner quotation inside a quotation, the inner marks are ‹ ›. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, the author's own paraphrases, Mark 11:26 (absent from OWB's critical text), and the few places where OWB's sense differs from the AV wording Finney argues from.

Judgement calls. Proverbs 14:14 'the backslider in heart': OWB has no 'in heart', and Lecture 21 is built on it, so the lecture's text and its twenty-one 'filled with his own …' heads keep the AV sense (self_rendered) and the title is unchanged. Isaiah 59:19, Job 21:30 and Proverbs 19:2 likewise read differently in OWB from the AV sense Finney applies, and stay self_rendered. Hab 3:2 'revive thy work' is OWB «በእኛ ዘመን ሥራህን አድስ» throughout. John 21:15-17 'feed my lambs' is OWB «ጠቦቶቼን መግብ», and 'Simon, son of Jona' OWB's 'son of John'. Gal 4:19 keeps Finney's appended 'the hope of glory' outside the quotation marks. 'What wilt thou have me to do?' is OWB Acts 22:10 (decision acts-9-6). The author's own 'Jehovah' (Lecture 4) follows OWB's እግዚአብሔር.
